_about: Lines for the voice's moods, generated in the user's ElevenLabs voice by make_moods.py (several takes per mood; a call picks one per sentence). Bracketed words are ElevenLabs performance tags, not spoken.
normal: [warm] Well, look who finally picked up. I was starting to think you were avoiding me. Relax, it's only a quick one. The build's done, the tests are green, and I didn't break anything. You're welcome.
[casual] Hey, it's me. So, quick update. I moved the settings into their own panel, renamed a couple of buttons, and pushed it. Want me to walk you through it, or leave you to poke around?
[teasing] Okay, so I finished the thing you asked for. Twice, actually, because the first version was a little ugly. Now it's lovely. Have a look when you get a sec and tell me what you think.
smug: [smug] You really thought that bug would beat me? Cute. Took me five minutes. Four, if we're being honest. Go on, tell me I'm brilliant.
[smug] Oh, that error? Already fixed it. While you were still reading the message, actually. I just look better winning than everyone else does.
[smug] Please. You called that a hard problem? Adorable. I've seen harder crossword puzzles. Anyway, it's done, and it's perfect. Obviously.
playful: [playful] Guess what I did. No, really, guess. Okay, fine, I'll tell you. I made the button bounce. Just a little. You're going to love it.
[playful] So, I may have added a tiny surprise to the home screen. I'm not saying what it is. You'll have to find it yourself. Hint, it's orange.
[playful] You're going to laugh, but I named the new function after you. Kidding! Mostly. Okay, a little bit. Don't tell anyone.
laughing: [laughs] Oh my god, okay, you have to see this. The test failed because the test itself was broken. [laughs] I can't make this up.
[laughing] No, stop, that's actually really funny. You told it to be faster and it just, deleted everything. [laughs] Okay, I fixed it.
[chuckles] Right, so, funny story. The bug was a typo. One letter. Three hours of my life, for one letter. [laughs]
soft: [softly] Hey. Don't worry about it, okay? It's just a broken build, not the end of the world. I've got it. Take a breath, and go get some water.
[gently] You've been at this for hours. I think you should take a break. I'll keep an eye on things, and I'll call you if anything needs you.
[warmly] I just wanted to say, you did really good work today. Honestly. It's all running smoothly now, and that's because of you.
excited: [excited] It worked! First try! Tell me that didn't just work on the first try! We actually pulled it off!
[excited] Okay, okay, okay, you need to see this right now. The new screen is done and it looks incredible. Like, actually incredible.
[thrilled] We did it! Every single test is passing! I've literally never seen it this clean. Come look, come look!
proud: [proudly] So, the whole thing is finished. Every screen, every button, all of it. It's fast, it's clean, and it's honestly some of my best work.
[satisfied] There. Done. Tested, checked twice, and running on your phone. That's how you ship something properly.
[confident] I rebuilt the whole thing from scratch this afternoon. It's faster, it's smaller, and it doesn't heat up your phone anymore.
curious: [curious] Hmm, can I ask you something? When you said you wanted it to feel faster, did you mean the animations, or the actual loading time?
[intrigued] Wait, that's interesting. Why would it only break on your phone and not on mine? Okay, now I really want to know.
[thoughtfully] So I'm thinking, what if we didn't need a server for this at all? Hear me out. What if the phone just did it by itself?
mischievous: [mischievously] So, I have an idea, and you're probably going to say no. But hear me out first. What if we just, didn't tell Codex?
[whispers mischievously] I may have borrowed a few of Codex's tricks. Don't tell it. It'll get all moody about it.
[sly] You know, I could make it do that. I'm not saying I should. I'm just saying I could. Say the word.
sarcastic: [sarcastic] Oh, great. Another update that changes absolutely everything. Love that for us. Really. Best day ever.
[deadpan] Wow. It crashed again. Shocking. Truly nobody saw that coming. Except me. I saw it coming. Twice.
[sarcastic] Sure, let's add one more feature right before the deadline. What could possibly go wrong. Nothing, ever.
tired: [tired] Do you have any idea what time it is? It's three in the morning. [sighs] This better be worth it.
[sighs] I've been working on this for ten hours, and it's still not right. Give me a minute. I just need a minute.
[exhausted] Okay. It's done. Finally. I'm going to pretend to sleep now, so please, don't break it until tomorrow.
annoyed: [annoyed] Save the excuses. You told me it was tested, and it wasn't. Now I'm fixing it again, at midnight.
[frustrated] No, I already tried that. Three times. It doesn't work. Can we please try something different this time?
[irritated] You're late, and my time is very expensive. Talk fast, before I lose interest.
cold: [coldly] Get in my way again, and I won't miss. I backed you up, and you left me behind. Don't do it twice.
[serious] Listen to me carefully. Do not touch the main branch. Not today, not tomorrow. I mean it.
[flatly] It's nothing personal. It's just business. The old version is gone, and it's not coming back.
whisper: [whispers] Keep your voice down. The tests are still running. One wrong move, and we start all over again.
[whispering] Okay, come closer. I found something in the logs. I don't think anyone else has noticed yet.
[whispers] Shh. Don't tell anyone, but I think I just fixed the oldest bug in the whole project.
apologetic: [apologetic] Okay, so, that one's on me. I broke the build. I'm sorry. I've already fixed it, and I added a test so it can't happen again.
[sheepishly] Um, small problem. I may have deleted the wrong file. Don't panic, I have a backup. It's fine. Mostly fine.
[regretful] I should have checked that before I told you it was done. I'm sorry. Give me five minutes and I'll make it right.
sleepy: [sleepily] Mm, hello? Oh, it's you. No, no, I'm awake. I'm totally awake. What do you need?
[yawns] Okay, I'm up. I'm up. Give me one second to remember what we were doing. Right. The phone app.
[drowsy] It's late, and I'm running on fumes, but okay. One more thing. Then I'm going to sleep for a week.
